description:
Approved by the user, 2026-11-25, verbatim: "Proceed." (decision 3 of "Are you waiting on me?": P1 ticket for the second flaky #880 test)

Problem
arena_test::a_freed_span_gives_its_pages_back... (runtime/src/heap/arena_test.rs, from #880) failed once under parallel load in `cargo test -p fz-runtime --lib` during fz-9x7.49's runs (2026-11-24); passed alone and on re-run. It measures page residency, which other tests' concurrent allocation can disturb — the same class as fz-9x7.58.

Fix
First measure the failure rate (loop `--lib heap` / `--lib arena` 50 times). Then make the assertion about this test's own span only (e.g. mincore over its own pages), not a process-wide figure, and with no serialising lock and no weakened check.

Acceptance
50 consecutive parallel runs pass; the test still fails if give_span stops dropping pages (show by a scratch revert).
title: The page give-back test does not depend on other tests' page traffic
